title: 🔥 FALLING IN LOVE WITH THE WRONG PERSON—HOW TO AVOID HEARTBREAK! 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 FALLING IN LOVE WITH THE WRONG PERSON—HOW TO AVOID HEARTBREAK! 🔥
📖 2 Corinthians 6:14 – "Do not be unequally yoked with unbelievers. For what partnership has righteousness with lawlessness? Or what fellowship has light with darkness?"

❓ READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, I’m in love with someone, but deep down, I know they’re not leading me closer to God. What should I do?"
🔥 POWERFUL QUESTION! Many people fall in love based on emotions, not realizing that the wrong relationship can pull them away from God, bring pain, and delay their purpose!
🚨 SATAN LOVES TO USE RELATIONSHIPS TO DISTRACT, WEAKEN, AND DESTROY BELIEVERS!
⚠️ WARNING: Not every person you love is from God. Not everyone who says they love you is meant to be with you.
💡 TODAY, YOU WILL LEARN HOW TO AVOID HEARTBREAK AND CHOOSE GOD’S BEST!

🔥 1. WHY DO PEOPLE FALL FOR THE WRONG PERSON?
📖 Proverbs 4:23 – "Above all else, guard your heart, for everything you do flows from it."
🔥 HERE’S WHY MANY FALL INTO BAD RELATIONSHIPS:

1️⃣ LONELINESS – They choose someone just to "feel loved."
2️⃣ LUST & EMOTIONS – Physical attraction blinds them to the person’s true character.
3️⃣ IGNORING RED FLAGS – They see warning signs but hope the person will change.
4️⃣ WORLDLY THINKING – They think love is just about feelings, not God’s design.
5️⃣ PRESSURE FROM OTHERS – Friends and family push them into relationships.
🚨 ARE YOU IN A RELATIONSHIP BECAUSE IT’S GOD’S PLAN OR BECAUSE OF YOUR FEELINGS?
💡 DON’T LET YOUR EMOTIONS LEAD YOU INTO A TRAP!

🔥 2. SIGNS YOU’RE IN LOVE WITH THE WRONG PERSON!
📖 Matthew 7:16 – "You will recognize them by their fruits."
🔥 IF YOUR RELATIONSHIP HAS THESE SIGNS, IT’S TIME TO PRAY AND RECONSIDER:

1️⃣ THEY PULL YOU AWAY FROM GOD – Instead of encouraging your faith, they distract you.
2️⃣ THEY DON’T SHARE YOUR VALUES – They don’t care about purity, marriage, or biblical principles.
3️⃣ THE RELATIONSHIP IS BUILT ON LUST, NOT LOVE – Passion is strong, but there’s no spiritual foundation.
4️⃣ YOU FEEL CONSTANT DOUBT AND CONFLICT – There’s no peace—only stress and emotional rollercoasters.
5️⃣ THEY REFUSE TO GROW IN CHRIST – They reject accountability and spiritual maturity.
🚨 GOD WILL NEVER SEND SOMEONE WHO PULLS YOU AWAY FROM HIM!
💡 LOVE SHOULD DRAW YOU CLOSER TO GOD, NOT AWAY!

🔥 3. HOW TO AVOID A HEARTBREAKING RELATIONSHIP
📖 Proverbs 3:5-6 – "Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding; in all your ways submit to Him, and He will make your paths straight."
🔥 HERE’S HOW TO PROTECT YOUR HEART:

✔️ PRAY BEFORE ENTERING A RELATIONSHIP – Ask God for wisdom and clarity.
✔️ LOOK FOR FRUIT, NOT JUST FEELINGS – Do they truly follow Jesus, or just pretend?
✔️ SET STRONG BOUNDARIES – Don’t compromise on purity and biblical values.
✔️ SEEK GODLY COUNSEL – Talk to strong believers for advice and wisdom.
✔️ BE WILLING TO WALK AWAY – If God says "NO," obey Him!
🚨 A RELATIONSHIP OUTSIDE GOD’S WILL LEADS TO PAIN—DON’T IGNORE HIS WARNING SIGNS!
💡 GOD’S PLAN FOR LOVE IS ALWAYS BETTER THAN YOURS!

🔥 4. WHY WAIT FOR GOD’S BEST?
📖 Psalm 37:4 – "Take delight in the Lord, and He will give you the desires of your heart."
🔥 WHEN YOU WAIT ON GOD, YOU RECEIVE:

✔️ A PARTNER WHO LOVES GOD FIRST – Someone who truly follows Christ.
✔️ A RELATIONSHIP BUILT ON FAITH, NOT LUST – True love, not just emotions.
✔️ A MARRIAGE THAT GLORIFIES GOD – A relationship that lasts.
✔️ PEACE INSTEAD OF HEARTBREAK – No regrets, only blessings.
🚨 STOP SETTLING FOR LESS THAN GOD’S BEST!
💡 TRUE LOVE FROM GOD IS WORTH THE WAIT!

🔥 FINAL WARNING: DON’T CHOOSE LOVE BASED ON EMOTIONS—CHOOSE IT BASED ON GOD’S WILL!
📖 Jeremiah 29:11 – "For I know the plans I have for you," declares the Lord, "plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future."

🔥 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
❌ Stay in a relationship that weakens your faith?
❌ Ignore red flags and risk future heartbreak?
✔️ Trust God and wait for His perfect plan?
🚨 WHEN GOD CLOSES A DOOR, DON’T FORCE IT OPEN—HE HAS SOMETHING BETTER!
💡 DO YOU TRUST GOD ENOUGH TO WAIT FOR HIS BEST?

🙏 PRAYER TO WAIT FOR GOD’S BEST!
"Lord Jesus, I surrender my love life to You. I don’t want to follow my emotions—I want to follow Your will. Protect me from relationships that are not from You, and help me wait for the person You have prepared for me. Give me wisdom, patience, and faith to trust in Your perfect plan. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!"
